name: AI Sales Intelligence
company: CAMP Aviate (formerly Component Control's Quantum Control)
summary: AI price guidance for aviation parts and MRO sales teams. It recommends a price for each part from your past quote outcomes, win rates and ILS marketplace data, sends weekly opportunity reports, and includes a plain-language AI analyst, all inside SalesEdge Quoting.
paragraphs: AI price guidance for aviation parts and MRO sales teams. It recommends a price for each part from your past quote outcomes, win rates and ILS marketplace data, sends weekly opportunity reports, and includes a plain-language AI analyst, all inside SalesEdge Quoting.
whyItMatters: For a parts seller, small pricing misses on thousands of RFQs add up. Ask it which customers bring the highest margin and which parts are not moving, then compare against what your reps believe.
